reponse: Loomly is getting a credit, not refunds. Finance approved a credit for the November payout fees on the 1,212 affected payouts, about $3,940, applied to their December 1 invoice, with no cash refunds and nothing paid to individual sellers [2][3]. Jenna Kowalski owns the ticket to add the credit line by December 1 [4], and company policy limits service credits to the customer's next invoice [5]. One support ticket says management approved a full refund of all November fees to every seller, but the finance approval [2] and the follow-up email [3] contradict that [1].
